claims.claim: Motivational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show titles matching these genres (e.g. 'How to Win Friends...', 'This Is Marketing', 'Seven Principles for Making Marriage Work').

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted
claims.evidence: Photos show no visible stains or damage on covers, but interior pages and true dryness cannot be assessed from the images.
No way to confirm moisture or water exposure from a photo; would require close-up of page edges or a handling video.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: 20 paperback/hardback books cannot plausibly weigh 500 kg; this figure is inconsistent with the item count and type shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Interior condition (foxing, torn pages, markings) not visible in flat-lay photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of open pages and spines for each book
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst-case used condition with possible interior wear

risks.risk: Whether the 20 books are sold as a complete lot or individually
risks.proof: Seller statement or listing text confirming 'sold as one lot' with all 20 included
risks.if_unproven: priced as uncertain lot completeness, worst case partial lot

risks.risk: Edition/printing year affecting value (especially for popular titles like 'Psychology of Money')
risks.proof: Photo of copyright page showing edition and year
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/older edition, lowest common value

risks.risk: Unverified and physically implausible weight claim may indicate a templated or fraudulent listing
risks.proof: Seller providing an actual photo of the books on a scale showing a realistic reading
risks.if_unproven: treated as a red flag; price frozen until clarified

proof_requests: Close-up shots of each book's spine and a few interior pages
Confirmation whether the lot is sold as all 20 together or separately
Photo of the actual scale reading used for weighing, if any genuine weight is relevant
Copyright/edition page photos for key titles
response.reason: The seller's claim of a 500 kg weight for 20 books is physically impossible and suggests a copy-pasted or fraudulent listing, so the report alone cannot support a safe price.
